paper_anchor.thesis: Long-running LLM agent context should be a structured address space rather than an opaque buffer.

canonical_flow.name: Goal
canonical_flow.description: The user, evaluator, or run defines the objective and budget.

canonical_flow.name: Address
canonical_flow.description: The agent or operator locates durable state by path, prefix, glob, or semantic query.

canonical_flow.name: Disclose
canonical_flow.description: The system materializes glance, overview, or detail according to the current need.

canonical_flow.name: Event
canonical_flow.description: Mutations and observations are recorded as ordered events.

canonical_flow.name: Evidence
canonical_flow.description: Reports, run state, cost, ratings, and artifacts make the trajectory inspectable.

canonical_flow.name: Feedback
canonical_flow.description: Ratings, GC policy, and evaluation outcomes feed back into future retrieval and analysis.

benchmark_report_schema.description: Shared evidence contract for dedicated Structure benchmark adapters.

capabilities.name: Shared Core Manifest
capabilities.description: All surfaces read the same paper/runtime contract and expose the same vocabulary for primitives, flows, surfaces, and run evidence.

surface_status.evidence: Rust local-core parses core/structure_core.json and CLI/TUI render the parsed contract.
Desktop shell renders the manifest through Rust local-core without requiring a backend service.
React imports the manifest as a typed read-only contract while preserving service-backed runtime behavior.

capabilities.name: Local Chat And Code-Agent Loop
capabilities.description: The Rust local products run an embedded event-sourced chat/code-agent loop with workspace opening, recent-turn context replay, code search, knowledge loading, tool planning, tool execution, synthesis, proposed code-change artifacts, reviewed proposal application, artifact writing, and terminal status.

surface_status.entrypoint: structure-local chat / structure-local run / structure-local proposals list/show/apply / structure-local tui
surface_status.evidence: CLI offers a Codex/OpenCode-style local chat command, returns JSON RunResult with replayed recent workspace turns, exposes proposed code-change artifacts, can apply reviewed proposals with a code_change_applied event, and TUI can run prompts plus dry-run/apply the latest reviewed proposal through the same Rust runtime.

Tauri commands invoke structure-local-runtime directly, render chat turns, replay recent workspace turns into new runs, and expose run events/final responses plus proposed code-change artifacts and reviewed proposal application without a backend service.

surface_status.entrypoint: Structure API run creation and SSE streaming
surface_status.evidence: Web run loop remains API-backed and shares event/run vocabulary instead of embedding the local runtime.

capabilities.name: Workspace Context And Knowledge
capabilities.description: Workspace state keeps stable paths for registered knowledge sources and separates metadata/listing from preview/detail.

surface_status.entrypoint: structure-local workspace create/list/show/replay and knowledge add/list/show/remove
surface_status.evidence: CLI manages workspace metadata, SQLite knowledge indexes, and previews original files; TUI can create/open workspaces with o, register knowledge paths with s, and remove registrations with x.

surface_status.entrypoint: create_local_workspace / local_workspaces / local_repo_entries / local_repo_search / read_local_repo_file / add_local_knowledge / read_local_knowledge_source / remove_local_knowledge
surface_status.evidence: Desktop UI supports workspace selection/creation, safe repository list/search/read tools, plus knowledge source add, preview, and metadata removal through the local runtime.

surface_status.entrypoint: Workspace context API and storage services
surface_status.evidence: Web workspace context remains backend-managed but follows path-addressed context semantics.

capabilities.name: Event Replay
capabilities.description: Ordered events can be replayed at run or workspace scope for debugging, evaluation evidence, and artifact inspection.

surface_status.entrypoint: structure-local runs events / structure-local workspace replay
surface_status.evidence: CLI emits JSON event streams and workspace replay bundles for automation.
Desktop UI can replay the workspace stream and inspect run evidence locally.

surface_status.entrypoint: SSE event stream and replay endpoints
surface_status.evidence: Service runs stream and persist events through the backend event-sourcing layer.

capabilities.name: Artifact Evidence
capabilities.description: Generated assistant responses and proposed code changes are addressable artifacts linked back to runs, events, and costs.

surface_status.entrypoint: structure-local artifacts list/show / structure-local proposals list/show/apply
surface_status.evidence: CLI lists artifact records, previews artifact files by artifact_id, and separates code-change proposals for review before explicit application.
Desktop UI previews the latest local artifact and latest code-change proposal, then applies reviewed proposals through the Rust runtime.

surface_status.entrypoint: Run artifacts and persisted cost/report state
surface_status.evidence: Service artifacts are linked to backend runs and persisted evaluation evidence.

primitives.name: Path-addressable context
primitives.invariant: Durable state has a stable hierarchical path and can be discovered by exact, prefix, glob, or semantic query.
primitives.implementation_contract: All product surfaces must preserve path identity when rendering, exporting, replaying, or evaluating context state.

surface_roles.role: Primary live workspace and run context surface.
Local artifact, proposal, and knowledge path inspection surface.
Scriptable path, proposal, and run diagnostics surface.

primitives.name: Multi-level disclosure
primitives.invariant: Every context object should be materializable as glance, overview, or detail without changing the underlying state.
primitives.implementation_contract: Interfaces should separate cheap listing/metadata views from full content previews and should record escalation counts in evaluation artifacts.

surface_roles.role: Executes disclosure choices during live agent runs.
Maps artifact, proposal, knowledge, metadata, and preview views to the same disclosure ladder for local review.
Exposes list/status/show commands as machine-readable disclosure levels.

primitives.name: Event-sourced audit
primitives.invariant: Every mutation is an ordered immutable event that can be streamed live and replayed offline.
primitives.implementation_contract: Live clients, local apps, and evaluation scripts must keep event identifiers and replay metadata visible in their outputs.

surface_roles.role: Streams and renders live run/workspace events.
Reads persisted evidence produced by local event replay and agent runs.
Provides reproducible event/report inspection for automation and CI.

primitives.name: Source evaluation
primitives.paper_section: method: Source Evaluation via Agent Ratings
primitives.invariant: Consulted context can receive bounded usefulness ratings that affect filtering, ranking, and later analysis.
primitives.implementation_contract: Ratings must be event-sourced and reported with enough metadata to separate filtering effects from reranking effects.

surface_roles.role: Produces and consumes ratings inside the live agent loop.
Surfaces rating evidence and score traces for local review.
Exports rating-aware run summaries and diagnostics.

primitives.name: Event-level garbage collection
primitives.invariant: GC is a visibility filter over events, not a destructive rewrite of storage.
primitives.implementation_contract: Run artifacts must include the GC policy and enough event counts to reproduce the live context at each step.

surface_roles.role: Applies GC policy while constructing the live agent working context.
Displays GC policy and retained/expired event evidence from local artifacts.
Exports GC-aware run evidence for evaluation workflows.

primitives.name: Reproducible evidence
primitives.invariant: Accuracy, token cost, latency, disclosure counts, ratings, and replay identifiers are preserved as inspectable evidence.
primitives.implementation_contract: All surfaces should expose the same run, event, artifact, and cost vocabulary so paper tables and local diagnostics refer to the same evidence objects.

surface_roles.role: Creates service-backed runs and records state for evaluation.
Makes local run and artifact evidence inspectable without a backend service.
Provides stable JSON/text outputs for local diagnostics and paper artifact checks.

surfaces.name: CLI/TUI
surfaces.runtime_model: Local Rust binary; no backend service required
primary_jobs: Proposal review and application from the terminal
surfaces.boundary: Operator tooling only; it should stay scriptable and should not become the product UI.

surfaces.name: Desktop App
surfaces.runtime_model: Tauri shell over local files and Rust commands
surfaces.boundary: User-facing local app; it should not expose terminal service controls as its main workflow.

surfaces.name: Web App
surfaces.audience: Browser users and collaborative service deployments
surfaces.runtime_model: React UI backed by Structure API services
surfaces.boundary: Service product surface; it remains separate from the offline local app and CLI/TUI.
